name: Financial Ledger Cumulative Balance with Duplicate Timestamp Ties
description: Ledger entries can occur at the exact same millisecond. Financial ledgers must preserve strict incremental balances rather than bunching peer rows.
prompt:
Ledger entries can occur at the exact same millisecond. Financial ledgers must preserve strict incremental balances rather than bunching peer rows.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: entry_id, account_id, posted_time, amount, running_balance.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Calculate strict running ledger balance using ROWS frame to prevent peer bunching
            SELECT 
                entry_id,
                account_id,
                posted_time,
                amount,
                -- ROWS frame evaluates row-by-row even when posted_time is identical
                SUM(amount) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY account_id
                    ORDER BY posted_time, entry_id
                    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                ) AS running_balance
            FROM ledger
            ORDER BY posted_time, entry_id;
why_it_fails: SQL window functions default to `RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`, which aggregates identical timestamps together into the same running total.
